title: Bifrost Bench release policy
description: policies/<name>.yaml: explicit rules a candidate arm must meet before it ships. Mirrors schemas.Policy. A policy only adds requirements: the baseline integrity gates always run and no field here can switch them off.

on_unknown.description: What an unknown result on a block-severity check does. Unset: a small-sample unknown (fewer runs than min_n even counting unknown runs) warns and any other unknown blocks.

judge_calibration.description: W8 judge calibration: thresholds of the judge_calibration instrument of judged experiments (docs/judge-calibration.md). Unset fields take the defaults.

min_agreement.description: Lowest allowed lower bound (exact 95%) of judge-human agreement. Default 0.75.

min_tnr.description: Lowest allowed lower bound (exact 95%) of the true negative rate. Default 0.60.

min_labels.description: Fewer human labels give a warning with the interval. Default 30.

max_age_days.description: A record older than this gets a reminder. Default 90.

check.description: One rule. Exactly one of rule, max, min or equals.

metric.description: A per-run metric name, or an aggregate: integrity_violations, cost_per_verified_success, or timeout_rate with rule timeout_parity.

condition.description: clean, a probe id, or all for every condition. Default: the experiment's primary condition.

rule.description: timeout_parity reads metric timeout_rate: the arm's and arm A's timeout rates must not be more than 10 pp apart while either is above 20%.

min_n.description: Fewer observed runs than this gives unknown. Default 1.
